apps.versionDescription:
Plezy v2.26.0 (Upstream 2.26.0 + PR #2729 + All Custom Fixes)

Included Upstream 2.26.0 Updates:
- Lower CPU use on 32-bit Android devices & ARM audio decoding
- Fixed subtitle memory leaks on seek & animated ASS subtitle CPU usage
- Audio passthrough fixes: lower CPU for E-AC-3, no frame drop on unpause
- Dolby Vision fixes: no green playback with Match Content Frame Rate on Android MPV, true black letterbox bars
- Subtitle sync fixes on Android TV boxes
- Shuffle entire movie or TV library
- Genres tab in libraries
- Multi-source selector in Continue Watching
- Remember zoom level per show, library, or globally
- Shaders and Ambient lighting on Apple devices
- Match Refresh Rate on macOS
- Crash fix on Android devices lacking Vulkan

Included Custom Fixes:
- Restores separate external-display playback on iOS 27 instead of screen mirroring (#2729)
- Keeps external playback active when screen locks (#2729)
- Auto-pauses on external display disconnection (#2729)
- Suppresses automatic PiP during external display playback (#2729)
- HTTP .strm direct play (#2631)
- DTS-HD audio fallback & MPV recovery (#2644)
- ExoPlayer progressive buffer stall prevention (#2653)
- Jellyfin active audio track selection (#2655)
apps.localizedDescription: Plezy is a modern, lightweight media player client for Plex and Jellyfin servers, featuring native hardware decoding, Direct Play, and smooth playback.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app needs to connect to your media servers on your local network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plezy uses location access when iOS requires it to detect your local network and connect to your media servers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Plezy needs photo library access so you can choose images to upload as media artwork.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes for Companion Remote pairing.
